# Navigation and permissions
{: .no_toc }

What each kind of person sees in the sidebar. The app hides what you can never use, and the server checks every action again, so this is a guide, not a guarantee.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| Section › Item | Screen | End user | App owner | Support | Billing admin | Superadmin |
|---|---|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|
| Personal › Home | [APP-01]({{ '/screens/app-01/' | relative_url }}) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Personal › Inbox | [NTF-01]({{ '/screens/ntf-01/' | relative_url }}) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Personal › Organizations | [ORG-01]({{ '/screens/org-01/' | relative_url }}) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Personal › Account | [ACC-01]({{ '/screens/acc-01/' | relative_url }}) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Personal › Plan & Billing | [BIL-01]({{ '/screens/bil-01/' | relative_url }}) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Personal › Settings | [SET-01]({{ '/screens/set-01/' | relative_url }}) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Administration › Users | [USR-01]({{ '/screens/usr-01/' | relative_url }}) | | | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Administration › Access | [ACX-05]({{ '/screens/acx-05/' | relative_url }}) | | ✓ | ✓ | | ✓ |
| Administration › Roles | [ROL-01]({{ '/screens/rol-01/' | relative_url }}) | | | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Administration › Audit Log | [AUD-01]({{ '/screens/aud-01/' | relative_url }}) | | | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ |
| Administration › Send notification | [NTF-06]({{ '/screens/ntf-06/' | relative_url }}) | | | | | ✓ |
| Developer › Applications | [APL-01]({{ '/screens/apl-01/' | relative_url }}) | | ✓ | | | ✓ |
| Developer › API Keys | [KEY-01]({{ '/screens/key-01/' | relative_url }}) | | ✓ | | | ✓ |
| Developer › Webhooks | [WHK-01]({{ '/screens/whk-01/' | relative_url }}) | | ✓ | | | ✓ |
| Developer › Tenant | [BIL-04]({{ '/screens/bil-04/' | relative_url }}) | | ✓ | ✓ | | ✓ |

The web Hub also has an **Operations** section (the Console) and **Reports** and **Integrations** items. They're web-only for now; see [Screens]({{ '/screens/' | relative_url }}).

## Platform permissions

| Permission | Typical holder |
|---|---|
| `users.list` | Support, Billing admin, Superadmin |
| `users.manage` | Superadmin |
| `entitlements.manage` | Support, Superadmin |
| `applications.manage` | Superadmin |
| `roles.manage` | Superadmin |
| `organizations.manage` | Superadmin |
| `billing.manage` | Support, Billing admin, Superadmin |
| `billing.refund` | Billing admin, Superadmin |
| `audit.view` | Support, Billing admin, Superadmin |
| `webhooks.manage` | Superadmin |
| `api_keys.manage` | Superadmin |
| `notifications.send` | Superadmin |
| `tenants.manage` | Support, Superadmin |
